findings.problem: Subject says "Detox". This is a banned health buzzword and implies a medical claim.
findings.fix: Use a plain subject with no health claim, e.g. "Your first cup from The Steep Club".

findings.problem: Preview uses pressure ("Last chance") and fake scarcity ("Boxes are going fast").
findings.fix: Replace with calm, honest text, e.g. "A monthly tea box, made for your cozy corner."

findings.problem: "Last chance! Hurry, this offer ends tonight." uses banned pressure words. It also states an offer and deadline the owner has not confirmed.
findings.fix: Remove it. If an offer exists, write it as `[Owner to confirm: ...]` and keep the tone calm.

findings.problem: "They are the best tea you can buy." is a banned "best" claim.
findings.fix: Say something honest and small, e.g. "Our small-batch loose-leaf teas are picked for a cozy cup."

findings.problem: A second link (kettlebird.example/boxes) breaks the rule of exactly one main link.
findings.fix: Delete the "see the boxes" line and keep only [Join now](https://kettlebird.example/steep-club).
